name: interleaved_rope
description: Interleaved multimodal RoPE selection. x is [3,S,D]; the output initially follows x[0], then for columns with d%3==1 and d<mrope_section[1]*3 it takes x[1], and for columns with d%3==2 and d<mrope_section[2]*3 it takes x[2]. mrope_section is a length-3 sequence; section[0] is unused. Returns a new [S,D] tensor. The Triton kernel requires the three planes of x to be contiguous. Current tests exercise bfloat16 with sections [8,8,8], [16,16,16] and [16,24,24].
